notes.title: Update 1.32
notes.notes: Update 1.32 is live now.  This update lets you play the Allied side for all of the Mission Pack South missions.  Subsequent updates will add this functionality to other missions.

notes.title: Artillery patch
notes.notes: This patch fixes a bug whereas computer controlled artillery was sometimes able to engage targets even when computer units did not have a line of sight on them.

notes.title: Update 1.31
notes.notes:
If you have Maneuver Warfare, please download Update 1.31.  This update includes the following improvements:
-better AI behavior during offensive operations as AI units will now attack only if they have a numerical superiority, otherwise, they will halt and engage in a firefight;
-allows you to play the Allied side in certain scenarios (Allied playability in other scenarios will follow in subsequent updates)
-performance improvements
Please note that this update will lead to errors with existing saved games.

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes: This patch fixes a bug that appeared with the last update. Please update your game.

notes.title: Update 1.30 live now.
notes.notes:
This update lets you play Allied units in Editor games.  When you are at the unit selection phase, just click on the flag of a country and then you will be able to acquire that country's units. Radio reports will now be given in the language of the selected country and the names of the report lines and your final objective on the map will be shown in that country's language.  Translations of the radio reports will appear in English in the message log.  Depending on the DLC you own, in adddition to Germany, you can select:
-Belgium
-Canada
-Czechoslovakia
-France
-Great Britain
-Netherlands
-Poland
-Soviet Union
-United States
-Yugoslavia
Future updates will enable playing some scenarios from the Allied side as well.

notes.title: Patch for Update 1.29
notes.notes: This patch fixes issues that came with the last update.  Specifically, it enables movement of headquarters units and capture of the final objective in the first Czechoslovak mission.  It also fixes issues with the German language audio.  Please update your game.

notes.title: Update 1.29 is live now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37465564/39383ad34951b36f3356aea5f38b793d72a4dc36.png[/img]If you have Maneuver Warfare, please get Update 1.29. The main changes in this update are:
-simplified air mission planning. You no longer need to select a Forward Air Controller nor click on a targeting cursor.  Both are done automatically.  The air mission window also indicates how many air missions you have available.
-simplified artillery planning. You no longer need to click on a targeting cursor – this gets done automatically. You still need to select an artillery unit, but now this is done directly from the artillery window so you don't need to look for one on the map.
-when you left click on units in the list at the bottom left, you can either add or remove them from a group. When you right click on a unit, it will deselect all others, selecting only this one and the camera will center on that unit on the map.
-when you hove a mouse over a unit in the list at the bottom left, the unit info window will display that unit's details.

notes.title: Maneuver Warfare Update 1.28 is live now
notes.notes:

-When indirect fire is requested, the target location will be marked on the map.  Same with air missions.
-When a game ends, all enemy units will become visible.
-Graphics improvements such as adding national flags in Editor country selections.
-New units added:
	-Poland: R35 tank company (base game)
	-Yugoslavia: 	
                        -infantry regiment combat support company (Mission Pack South)
			-FT17 tank company (Mission Pack South)
			-cavalry squadron (Mission Pack South)
	-USA: 	-engineer platoon (Mission Pack West 44-45)
			-engineer platoon, mechanized (Mission Pack West 44-45)
			-assault engineer platoon (Mission Pack West 44-45)
			-assault engineer platoon, mechanized (Mission Pack West 44-45)
-New editor formations added
	-Yugoslavia:	
                        -1st tank battalion – R35 (Mission Pack South)
			-2nd tank battalion – FT17 (Mission Pack South)
                         -machine gun battalion (Mission Pack South)

Select a battalion from the unit list, chose a formation, click on the map and all of the battalion's units will deploy. If you deploy in single file, the HQ will be 2nd in the order of march.

notes.title: Update 1.07 live now!
notes.notes:
The main focus of this update was to add command windows that allow a player to give artillery/air support/mine laying orders without resorting to using the keyboard.  These also provide flexibility by allowing to set the start time or length of a fire mission and start time of an air mission.  The command windows also let the player set unit actions on coming under effective enemy fire.  
Other changes include an optional start point for the Grand Campaign and a scatter of multiple rocket launcher fire.

notes.title: Maneuver Warfare v1.05 update going live!
notes.notes:
Maneuver Warfare v1.05 update contains the following:

1.  Units the player receives in single games may have veteran or elite status.  The probability of a unit havins such status increases with every year of the war starting with battles set in 1940.  This feature does not apply to editor-created games but will be available for editor games in a later update.
2.  A bug whereas the "deployment complete" or "regrouping information" buttons reappear when a saved game loads in the middle of a battle has been removed.
3.  A bug that prevented the population of battalion element lists in the unit list at the bottom left of the screen following a load has been removed.

Update 1.06 is currently in the works and the main feature of that will be detailed battle reports.

notes.title: Maneuver Warfare Update 1.04 is live now on Steam.
notes.notes:
Update 1.04 is now Live on Steam.  This update includes:

-Group Movement.  Select a battle group using the unit menu at the bottom left of the screen.  Then click on the "Enable Group Movement" button and select units in the grouping that you want to move together.  Then click on a destination on the map and the units will move.  Note that group movement is available only for those battle groups that have a headquarters element.  Manually selecting a unit on the map will disable group movement.  

-Unit Menu.  Located on the bottom left of the screen, the menu identifies all of your battle groups and their component units.  The menu can be minimized using the "X" button attached to it.

-Mini Map minimization option.  The Mini Map can now be minimized using the "X" button attached to it.
